references.text: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as this verse indicates. Verse 48 mentions that the redemption money was given to Aaron and his sons.
The verse refers to the Lord's command to Moses, which is a repetition of obedience to God's word.
The redemption price for the firstborn is also mentioned here, where the amount of five shekels is noted as the redemption payment.
The text deals with redeeming the firstborn, which is the background for the redemption money Moses collected.
Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded him, reflecting the obedience described in Num 3:51.
The Levites were taken instead of the firstborn in Israel, and any surplus had to be redeemed with money.
